Name: Asaiah, Servant of the King
Summary: Asaiah, a servant of the king, was one of the men Josiah commanded to enquire of the LORD concerning the found book, and he went to Huldah the prophetess.
KeyStory: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam, Abdon, Shaphan and Asaiah a servant of the king's to enquire of the LORD.
LifeLesson: Even a king's servant shared the errand of enquiring of God.
